{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of QA orders in full dataset:", qa_mask.sum())

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
print("Number of refunded orders in full dataset:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH, excluding QA and refunded
filtered = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    ~qa_mask &
    ~refunded_mask
]

print("Filtered data shape after excluding QA and refunded:", filtered.shape)

# Now compute conversion fraction: completed / total in filtered group
completed_count = (filtered['status'] == 'completed').sum()
total_count = len(filtered)
conversion_fraction = completed_count / total_count

print(f"Completed conversions: {completed_count}")
print(f"Total in group: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Final validation
assert len(filtered) > 0, "No valid NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH remain after filtering"
assert (filtered['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum() == 0, "QA orders still in filtered group"
assert (filtered['status'] == 'refunded').sum() == 0, "Refunded orders still in filtered group"

conversion_fraction"}
